document.abstract: One of the great benefits of the Society are the many educational activities that it provides to members, and the industry at large. Along with Membership and our Standards development work, Education is one of the three pillars that define this organization. Not only is this critical to a professional association, it is part of the reason we are designated a non-profit by the U.S. Internal Revenue Service.
